statement: In ecology-v2, changing only weighted deficit aggregation from power mean p=1 to p=4 reduces the worst behavioral criterion ratio after 20000 training steps without sacrificing another need.
rationale: Earlier studies showed hunger improvement at the expense of other needs. A power mean gives a larger marginal influence to the larger normalized deficit while retaining weights, normalization, clipping and the existing reward mapping. This is an original bounded adaptation, not a replication of the source model.
falsification: Do not promote p=4 if fewer than two of three paired training seeds improve worst criterion ratio by at least 10%, or if mean hunger, thermal MAE or wildlife proximity worsens by more than 10% relative to p=1. Also require improvement over untrained on hunger and temperature in at least two seeds. All six fixed behavior criteria must be reported; reward cannot override failure.

sources.title: Homeostatic reinforcement learning for integrating reward collection and physiological stability
sources.sectionsRead: Results: Theory sketch, Eq.1-5; Behavioral plausibility of drive, Eq.6-9; competition between motivational systems; Stepping back from the brink
sources.mechanism: Nonlinear aggregation of physiological deviations changes relative marginal incentives and competition between needs.
sources.limitations: The paper studies a family with separate m,n and drive reduction. The chosen p=4 weighted normalized power mean and legacy level/improvement reward mapping are our hypothesis; the paper does not establish their effectiveness. Live safety is a spatial proxy, and physical normalization is not equal biological urgency. No claim about survival or risk aversion follows from this pilot.

sources.title: Live prior drive-motivation results
sources.sectionsRead: Results, per-need tradeoffs and seed variability
sources.limitations: Historical physics differ from ecology-v2; use to identify a question, not as comparable performance data.

protocol.checkpointRule: Use the final 20000-step policy for decisions. Report 0/10000/20000 curves; do not select best checkpoints.
protocol.controls: Paired p=1; runner random, untrained and initial frozen inference policies; validated ecology-v2 passive/active audit. A one-phase experiment labels the frozen-at-start control initial.
protocol.primary: Per training seed, average each metric across evaluation seeds then max(value/threshold) for temperature.mae/1.2, temperature.outside/.35, hunger.mean/.35, hunger.above/.1, wildlife.proximity/.12, wildlife.contact-proxy/.01. Do not pool evaluation seeds as independent training replicates.
protocol.secondary: All physical and ecology metrics, prolonged hunger and thermal excursions, food eaten, movement reversal and learning curves. No joint learning changes.
protocol.decision: Apply falsification gate before any independent full study. If negative, inspect credit horizon/exploration before choosing the next separately registered learning hypothesis.
